verdict.rationale: Sardine documents that at least one workflow, business verification, can be done either in the dashboard or through the async /businesses API, and it ingests transaction data through APIs. This is evidence of some UI/API overlap, but nothing claims general parity. Several capabilities are described only as dashboard actions: generating invites under Admin, creating a new verification by clicking New Verification, the no-code rule editor, and the case management workspace. missing for 10: an explicit API-parity claim, API coverage for admin/user management, rules and case management, and public API reference evidence (the API docs are protected).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Business verification can be done through the Middesk or Sardine dashboard as well as via the async /businesses API.
Sardine can digest transaction data from our clients' platforms through its flexible APIs
